channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The strongest signals this period are outside-capital commitments: Aerostar's $173M LMM airport parking structure, Aman's Amantaru resort inside the $2B-plus Esencia development in Cabo Rojo, a $41.6M Hyatt Place in Ponce backed by federal CDBG-DR funds, and Aeroméxico's new Mexico City–San Juan route for June 2027. Mainland brands (Fazoli's, Pep Boys, Hilton) continue expanding, and AES is negotiating a Guayama plant extension with a planned investment of about $820M. Risks cluster in energy and the broader economy: the energy czar is pressing LUMA over roughly $1B in unspent funds, PREPA debt remains stalled, and Genera forecasts high outage rates through 2030. The New York Fed describes a flat economy, and auto sales are down 11.8%. Encanto Restaurants' bankruptcy after Yum! Brands ended its franchise agreements is a notable employment and credit event, with Popular exposed.
